title: Reputation as Code
subtitle: How Technical Professionals Build Career Sovereignty Through Proof of Work
author: Alex Merced
synopsis: Stop sending resumes into the black hole of automated applicant tracking systems. In Reputation as Code, Head of Developer Relations and O'Reilly author Alex Merced breaks down how to engineer career sovereignty the same way you build reliable software: through public artifacts, repeatable content pipelines, modular output, and authentic community generosity. Written from the perspective of an engineer and educator who pivoted into tech in his mid-30s, this book provides an actionable blueprint for turning your technical skills, non-linear background, and curiosity into unstoppable inbound gravity.
